miller_record.name: Miller's Ledger
miller_record.greeting: The figures are neat. That makes them worse.
lines: Cartloads of ash entered Greyfen as fertilizer. The weights match the missing refugee wagons.

actions.label: Preserve the ledger
actions.result: The ledger will speak at the assembly.

captain_senn.name: Captain Senn
captain_senn.greeting: I wore Vargan colors. I stopped when the orders stopped sounding like war.
lines: I barred the road. Halvern refused. They hanged him before dawn. That is the whole of my courage.

actions.label: Leave and never return
actions.result: Senn leaves his banner in the mud.

actions.label: Answer for the dead
actions.result: The road takes one more soldier.

halvern.name: Sir Halvern
halvern.greeting: Do not call me loyal. I obeyed until obedience became murder.
lines: Edric inherited the ledger. He also inherited every morning he chose not to open it.

assembly_choice.name: Greyfen Assembly
assembly_choice.greeting: No one speaks first. They are waiting to learn which version of themselves survives tonight.
lines: Kael places the ledger beside Oren's red thread. Neither needs embellishment.

witness_-7.name: Mira Fen
witness_-7.greeting: I knew what fed the roots.
lines: Medicine made the knowing useful. It did not make it clean.

witness_-3.name: Rook
lines: People redraw them until they do.

witness_3.name: Sister Anwen
witness_3.greeting: The shrine taught Greyfen how to forget.
lines: I kept that teaching alive. I will answer for it.

edric_campaign.name: Lord Edric Vargan
edric_campaign.greeting: I did not order the killing. I only inherited the proof.
lines: Then I chose Greyfen's peace every morning I kept the ledger shut.

actions.label: Expose him now
actions.result: The Vargan seal passes into public hands.

white_hart.name: The White Hart
white_hart.greeting: At last, the road has witnesses on both sides of death.
lines: Do not ask which choice is clean. Ask which debt you are willing to carry awake.

actions.label: Mercy: release me, keep selected guilt
Duty: bind the covenant to Kael

witness_7.name: The Record
lines: The page leaves room for names no living mouth remembers.

side_contracts.name: Greyfen's Smaller Miseries
side_contracts.greeting: Ten requests crowd the lower board. None offers only coin.
lines: Each name belongs to someone who will remember whether Kael came.

crow_shrine_choice.name: The Crow Shrine
crow_shrine_choice.greeting: Wax runs upward when Kael touches the stone.
lines: A promise can be cleaned, opened, or carried. None undo it.

actions.label: Cleanse the shrine
actions.result: The candles burn clean and cold.

retain_evidence.name: Oren's Token
retain_evidence.greeting: The scratched-out name catches against Kael's glove.
lines: Keeping evidence is not the same as protecting it.

village_stories.name: The Lives Beside the Road
village_stories.greeting: Small promises wait beside the larger crime.
lines: Each answer changes who stands at Greyfen's final assembly.

actions.label: Return Harl's bell to Elna
actions.result: Elna rings the bell once, then cuts its cord.

actions.label: Forge the massacre iron into names
actions.result: Tor stamps names where a blade's edge would be.

actions.label: Let Mira heal with confessed ash
actions.result: Mira labels every draught with its true cost.

actions.label: Spare the black guardian
actions.result: The black dog keeps watch beyond the sheepfold.

actions.label: Name the soldier who walked home
actions.result: An empty grave receives a name.

actions.label: Give the ash measure to the assembly
Preserve Rook's first road
actions.result: Rook draws the road as it was.

actions.label: Light Bram, Sella, and Oren's candles
actions.result: Three flames hold against the dusk.

names_decision.name: The Refugee Register
names_decision.greeting: The names are leverage only while they remain hidden.
lines: Kael has used people as tools before. He knows the sound of the thought.

actions.label: Publish every recovered name
actions.result: Copies of the names appear on every door.

actions.label: Use the names against the curse first
actions.result: The register stays in Kael's coat.
